question: Which global entity designated 2025 as the International Year of Quantum Science and Technology?
solution:
The correct answer is __**United Nations (UN)**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The **United Nations (UN)** designated **2025** as the **International Year of Quantum Science and Technology** to emphasize its significance in shaping modern science and technology. 
• This decision was made to foster a global understanding of **quantum technologies**, which have applications in various fields, including **computing, communication, sensing, and cryptography**. 
• The declaration aims to promote **collaboration among nations** to advance research and development in quantum science, ensuring equitable access to its benefits. 
• Quantum science has the potential to revolutionize industries such as **healthcare, defense, artificial intelligence, and sustainable energy**, making its global recognition crucial. 
• The UN's role in declaring international observances highlights its efforts to unite countries for addressing global challenges and fostering scientific progress. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
• **United Nations (UN):** 
• The **United Nations** is an international organization founded in **1945** with the aim of promoting global peace, security, and cooperation among nations.</l
